### middleware?

```ts
optional middleware?: GenerationMiddleware<unknown>[];
```

Defined in: [packages/ai/src/activities/generate3dMotion/index.ts:133](https://github.com/TanStack/ai/blob/main/packages/ai/src/activities/generate3dMotion/index.ts#L133)

**`Experimental`**

Observe-only middleware (`otelMiddleware()`, persistence, custom).

Stream mode: one run from submit to result.
Submit mode: the submit opens the run, and the [get3dMotionJobStatus](../functions/get3dMotionJobStatus.md)
poll that sees a terminal state closes it. Pass the same `middleware`
and `threadId` to both.

### runId?

```ts
optional runId?: string;
```

Defined in: [packages/ai/src/activities/generate3dMotion/index.ts:122](https://github.com/TanStack/ai/blob/main/packages/ai/src/activities/generate3dMotion/index.ts#L122)

**`Experimental`**

Run id for the stream chunks (stream mode only). A non-streaming submit
ignores it: that run id is derived from the provider job, so
[get3dMotionJobStatus](../functions/get3dMotionJobStatus.md) can find the same run from the job id alone.

***

### stream?

```ts
optional stream?: TStream;
```

Defined in: [packages/ai/src/activities/generate3dMotion/index.ts:110](https://github.com/TanStack/ai/blob/main/packages/ai/src/activities/generate3dMotion/index.ts#L110)

**`Experimental`**

`false` (default): submit the job and return `{ jobId, model }`. Poll
it later with [get3dMotionJobStatus](../functions/get3dMotionJobStatus.md).

`true`: return an `AsyncIterable<StreamChunk>` that submits the job,
polls it, and ends with `generation:result` and `RUN_FINISHED`.
